## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
```

```{r}
penguins_summary <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    average_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

penguins_summary
```

```{r}
ggplot(penguins, aes(x = bill_length_mm,
                     y = bill_depth_mm,
                     color = species)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Penguin Bill Length vs. Bill Depth",
    x = "Bill Length (mm)",
    y = "Bill Depth (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

This analysis compares bill length and bill depth across three penguin species.
